what: A whole-file JOC syntax scan of sixteen library titles chosen across sources, and what it found: downmix configuration 4, which no stream measured before had ever carried
why: the counts behind three open rows came from 31 streams in the working directory. The library holds 111 more object-carrying tracks, and every count that closed or failed to close a row is a per-frame encoder decision. Head clips are what hid sparse mode the first time, so this reads whole files.
sample: sixteen titles stratified by source rather than drawn at random, because 112 of the library's 113 object tracks use configuration 3 with 15 objects and unity clip gain and most are UHD disc remuxes from one encoder chain

streams_with_coarse: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny (2023).mkv#2
The Lord of the Rings The Two Towers (2002).mkv#2
The Hobbit The Desolation of Smaug (2013).mkv#2

coverage.reading: 77 858 940 object updates added to the 32 493 245 already scanned  for 110 352 185 in 50 JOC streams. Two data points: still zero. EMDF in auxdata: still zero frames. Configurations 1 and 2: still unseen.

what_changed_in_the_negatives.was: sparse and coarse appear only in streaming material
what_changed_in_the_negatives.now: false. Dangal, a Blu-ray remux, carries 15 sparse objects, and eight streams across discs and streaming carry coarse quantisation.

what_changed_in_the_negatives.was: downmix configurations 1, 2 and 4 never occur; relabelling cannot make any
what_changed_in_the_negatives.now: configuration 4 occurs: three of the sixteen titles carry it. 1 and 2 are still unseen.

configuration_4.structure: every one is an AC-3 core plus an E-AC-3 dependent substream, chanmap 0xa010, giving L C R Ls Rs LFE Vhl Vhr -- a 5.1.2 programme. Before the dependent-substream work these decoded as 5.1 and the configuration was structurally unreachable, which is why it had never been seen.

defect_found.what: the JOC downmix input mapping was written for configuration 1 alone. Table 47 of TS 103 420 gives the downmix channels per configuration: 1 ends `Lb, Rb`, the rear surround pair, while 2 and 4 end `Tfl, Tfr`, the top front pair that table E.1.4 of TS 102 366 calls Vhl and Vhr.
defect_found.symptom: the object decode refused with "the programme channels [...] do not cover the 7-channel JOC downmix" rather than producing wrong output, so nothing was silently mis-decoded

window_where_the_height_pair_carries_sig.note: those two carry an RMS of 0,000001 in both decoders, so the figure is the ratio of two noise floors and not a measurement

the_order_of_the_top_pair_is_measured_no.control: the same decode with Tfl and Tfr swapped

default_window.reading: identical, and that is the trap: the height channels are digitally silent in the opening of this title, so the window the comparison tool uses by default cannot see the difference

window_at_110_s.reading: swapping the pair costs 29 dB where the pair carries signal

configuration_4.what_this_settles: the 90-degree phase correction of configurations 3 and 4 was implemented for 3 and assumed to hold for 4, with the note "no stream to test". There is a stream now, and it holds.

clause_8_2_is_exercised_at_last.clause: TS 103 420 clause 8.2: when dependent substreams exist, the EMDF container carrying the object metadata shall be in the last dependent substream of the bitstream
clause_8_2_is_exercised_at_last.why_it_had_never_been_checked: it needs a stream that has both a dependent substream and object metadata, and no stream measured before had both. The counter that reports a container found in the independent part while dependents exist was added as evidence and had nothing to report on.
clause_8_2_is_exercised_at_last.material: the configuration 4 streams: Green Book and Dangal, ten minutes each
clause_8_2_is_exercised_at_last.reading: every container is in the dependent substream, none in the independent one. The encoder agrees with the clause, and the placement rule is exercised rather than implemented and untested.
clause_8_2_is_exercised_at_last.and_it_confirms_the_audit: a decoder that filters dependent substreams out finds zero containers in these streams and therefore no objects at all. That is exactly what the audit predicted when it wrote that clause 8.2 puts the metadata in the last dependent substream and nothing was looking there.
